title: Advisor filter on the expanded Billing Efficiency chart
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. You are in one location (workplace) with the data below.
  3. You use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).
  4. At least two service advisors each have an invoiced work order with clocked time this month in this location.
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  2. On the Billing Efficiency tile, click View details.
  3. Read the filter button at the top right of the Billing Efficiency chart and the chart's legend.
  4. Click the filter button and read the list.
  5. Choose one advisor (any advisor in the list).
  6. Try to choose a second advisor as well.
  7. Read the chart's legend and lines.
  8. Clear the advisor choice so no advisor is chosen.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Billing Efficiency chart has an Advisor filter.
  • Before anything is chosen, the chart shows every advisor (the legend lists all of them).
  • Only one advisor can be chosen at a time: choosing a second one replaces the first.
  • With one advisor chosen the chart reloads and shows only that advisor's line.
  • With the choice cleared, all advisors show again.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9580 (Story 8, Chart Filters); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 8. Split out of C88619. Design canvas (claude.ai/artifact/Wae9DFQ8PJQBy8mbLsL5ge, screenshots of the SV-8311 build captured 2026-09-28) board 05_Billing_After, used for on-screen labels only.
